    self._run_ingest_job(args)
    import time

    poll_interval = 0.5
    waited = 0
    while self.ingest_queue_has_pending_jobs() and waited < max_wait_seconds:

def forward(self, x, rel_pos_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor]=None):
    (B, N, C) = x.shape
    qkv_bias = None
    if self.q_bias is not None:
        qkv_bias = torch.cat((self.q_bias, torch.zeros_like(self.v_bias), self.v_bias))
    qkv = F.linear(input=x, weight=self.qkv.weight, bias=qkv_bias)
    qkv = qkv.reshape(B, N, 3, self.num_heads, -1).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
    (q, k, v) = qkv.unbind(0)
    q = q * self.scale
    attn = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)
    if self.relative_position_bias_table is not None:
        relative_position_bias = self.relative_position_bias_table[self.relative_position_index.view(-1)].view(self.window_size[0] * self.window_size[1] + 1, self.window_size[0] * self.window_size[1] + 1, -1)
        relative_position_bias = relative_position_bias.permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous()
        attn = attn + relative_position_bias.unsqueeze(0)
    if rel_pos_bias is not None:
        attn = attn + rel_pos_bias
    attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
    attn = self.attn_drop(attn)
    x = (attn @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, -1)
    x = self.proj(x)
    x = self.proj_drop(x)
    return x
